title: Prevalence of Glaucoma in the Israeli Arab Population
brief_summary: there is a variety of glaucoma prevalence within different populations. this study examine the prevalence of glaucoma in the Arab population in Israel' as well as the demographic variables and the compliance to treatment in the population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cup-to-disk ratio (CDR) \> 0.5 with asymmetry between the eyes
* Intraocular pressure (IOP) \> 23 mm Hg
* Damage to the field of vision
* Age- above 20 Yrs. old

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: primary care clinics from 1 Arab city in the center of Israel
